prompt_en: Create a complex photographic concept showing a coherent visible moment with the reference-guided person. Use the supplied portrait as visual reference for face and hair: retain its softly tapered facial outline, large dark eyes, natural lip shape, and short dark bob with wispy fringe. The main figure is a fictional adult stage performer whose invented role and circumstances belong to this photograph. Inside an old opera dressing room between the final rehearsal and the opening stage call, she pauses the hurry to return a borrowed silver flower brooch to her colleague. The performer stands in the foreground, her weight settled over her rear leg, wearing a sleeveless smoke-gray satin stage gown with a softly defined waist. Both arms wear long glossy black latex gloves; their smooth reflective surfaces rise above the elbows, with both upper-arm glove edges exposed below her bare shoulders. A narrow black choker collar encircles her neck, carrying a large polished silver O-ring at the front, its circular opening clearly visible above the gown. The front of the black band ends in two short mounting tabs that grip opposite sides of the ring; through its open middle, a patch of the performer's real neck skin catches the warmer vanity light. Her elbows bend comfortably beside her waist and both forearms extend toward the colleague. She makes a small offering gesture with open upward-facing palms, the six-centimeter silver flower brooch resting across the two gently cupped gloved hands. Her colleague stands to the right, holding a folded rehearsal schedule in the left hand and pausing with the right hand open just beyond the brooch. The colleague's attention has shifted from the doorway to the offered object. The performer looks up at that colleague, her lips holding a tiny dark seam after the quiet word, her jaw relaxed and barely lowered, the teeth screened by the lips at this three-quarter angle, and the corners of her mouth soften; the colleague answers with a small relieved smile. The bright ornament between them, the stopped step, and the waiting open hand make the thank-you pause visible. A travel trunk left open beside a rack of stage costumes suggests the work that was still being cleared away. Warm candlelight from the vanity grazes the performer's cheek, gloves, and silver ring; cool blue moonlight from the tall dressing-room window traces the other side of her bob and falls across the floor. Real candle flames and the blue-lit window remain visible as distinct light sources. Photograph from conversational distance with a 50 mm lens at eye height, a slight three-quarter view, in a vertical knees-up environmental frame containing both faces, the performer's complete elbows and glove tops, both offered palms, and the receiving hand. Use enough depth of field to keep the exchange and facial details clear while the costume rack recedes softly. Real skin texture, subtle satin folds, believable reflected light on latex, and gently restrained film grain support a photographic, emotionally quiet theatrical fashion editorial.
